quests.desc: Welcome to another profound game of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First step, take the rectangular passkey from the stand. And then, insert the rectangular passkey into the rectangular gate inside the pantry's lock to unlock it. After that, ensure that the rectangular gate inside the pantry is open. And then, travel west. And then, try to head west. After that, attempt to venture west. With that done, attempt to go south. With that done, try to go to the east. After that, attempt to move east. Next, go to the south. With that over with, go west. And then, venture west. After that, make an attempt to venture south. If you can succeed at that, try to head east. After that, move south. With that done, venture east. And then, make an attempt to go north. That done, try to head east. And then, go to the south. With that done, pick up the latchkey from the floor of the studio. And if you do that, you're the winner!

objective: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First, it would be good if you could recover the rectangular passkey from the stand. After that, unlock the rectangular gate within the pantry. After that, make it so that the rectangular gate is ajar. And then, make an attempt to take a trip west. And then, try to head west. With that done, make an attempt to move west. Then, make an attempt to move south. Then, attempt to go east. After that, go east. And then, attempt to travel south. With that done, travel west. Then, take a trip west. With that over with, try to move south. Then, venture east. After that, try to travel south. After that, go to the east. And then, go north. Once you succeed at that, make an effort to head east. After that, take a trip south. With that over with, recover the latchkey from the floor of the studio. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
